intro.text: This Privacy Policy describes how East Texas Mack ("we," "us," or "our") collects, uses, and shares personal information when you visit or interact with https://www.easttexasmack.com/ (the "Site").
We are committed to protecting your privacy and providing clear, transparent information about how personal data is handled.

copy.text: Personal Information You Provide
We may collect personal information that you voluntarily submit through our Site, including:

bullets.item: Any information submitted through forms, chat features, or inquiries

copy.text: You are not required to provide personal information to browse our Site; however, certain features or services may require it.
When you visit our Site, we automatically collect certain information about your device and usage, including:
This information is referred to as Device Information and is collected using cookies and similar technologies.
We use cookies and similar tracking technologies to operate and improve our Site, understand visitor behavior, and support analytics and marketing activities.
These technologies may include:

bullets.item: Session replay or interaction monitoring tools

copy.text: This information is referred to as Device Information and is collected using cookies and similar technologies.

Essential Cookies
Required for the Site to function properly and cannot be disabled through our systems.

Analytics Cookies
Used to understand how visitors interact with the Site so we can improve performance and usability.

Functional Cookies
Used to remember preferences and enhance functionality.

Marketing and Advertising Cookies
Used to measure advertising performance and deliver relevant content.
Where required by law, non-essential cookies are not placed until you provide consent. You may manage or withdraw your cookie preferences at any time through our cookie consent banner or settings.
Declining non-essential cookies will not prevent you from accessing the Site.
Where applicable under data protection laws, including the GDPR, we process personal information based on one or more of the following legal bases:

bullets.item: Our legitimate interests in operating and improving our Site
Performance of a contract or pre-contractual steps

copy.text: We use personal information to:

bullets.item: Support marketing and advertising activities (where permitted)
Comply with legal and regulatory obligations

copy.text: We may share personal information with trusted third-party service providers who assist us in operating our business, including:
These providers are authorized to use personal information only as necessary to perform services on our behalf.
We may also disclose personal information if required by law, regulation, subpoena, or legal process.
We may engage in advertising activities that involve the use of cookies or similar technologies to measure performance or deliver relevant content.
We do not sell personal information for monetary consideration. However, under certain U.S. state privacy laws, some advertising activities may be considered a "sharing" of personal information.
You may opt out of such sharing through:

bullets.item: Contacting us using the information below

copy.text: Depending on your state of residence, you may have the right to:

bullets.item: Know what personal information we collect
Opt out of the sale or sharing of personal information
Limit the use of sensitive personal information (if applicable)

copy.text: We do not knowingly collect or use sensitive personal information for purposes that require limitation under applicable laws.
Where required by law, we recognize and honor Global Privacy Control (GPC) browser signals as a valid request to opt out of certain data sharing activities.

We retain personal information only for as long as reasonably necessary to fulfill the purposes described in this Policy, unless a longer retention period is required or permitted by law.

We implement reasonable technical and organizational safeguards designed to protect personal information. However, no method of transmission or storage is completely secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.
Our Site may contain links to third-party websites. We are not responsible for the privacy practices of those sites and encourage you to review their privacy policies.
Our Site is not intended for children under the age of 13, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from children. We do not knowingly sell or share personal information of minors.
We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Any changes will be posted on this page with an updated effective date.
If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or wish to exercise your privacy rights, please contact: easttexasmack2024@gmail.com
